headline: Alebrijes and Nahuales bring color and stories to Salinas
summary: Eight 20-foot-tall “alebrije” sculptures arrived in Salinas on July 31, as part of the international exhibit “Alebrijes and Nahuales: Fantastic Animals from Mexico” to different places…
